notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve just released a major update for Arcane Path! Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]A brand new artifact with 5 unique new cards![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A complete overhaul of the artifact reward system: Artifacts are now unlocked by defeating specific bosses, reading story chapters, or talking to NPCs. This is the system we plan to keep for the full release![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Balance improvements: Battles should now feel a bit faster, as we’ve reduced HP and armor on some of the tankier enemies.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’ve fixed a ton of bugs and made overall improvements.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]This demo version is intended to be our final one before release this fall (except for bugfixes, of course).[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all again for playing Arcane Path and sharing your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183476/02841779a404d13047692c1316484cce52763a7c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Arcane Path Demo Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re thrilled to finally share this with you — the Arcane Path demo is now live on Steam!

This is our first public release, and we’ve packed it with everything we love about roguelike deckbuilders: powerful builds, high replayability, and a world you’ll want to explore piece by piece.

Here’s what you’ll find in the demo:

[h2]Explore the Ruined City[/h2]
The demo features the first map of the game - a desolate and dangerous place known as the Ruined City. This is where your journey begins, among the remnants of ancient Antioch.

[h2]7 Unique Artifacts[/h2]
Choose from 7 artifacts (out of 12 planned for full release).
Each artifact provides:

A unique starting deck

A status effect that shapes your playstyle

Access to exclusive cards tied to that artifact

Every run plays differently. Experiment with builds, discover synergies, and adapt to the path ahead.

[h2]Story Chapters with Hand-Painted Art[/h2]
The first 7 chapters of the in-game book are now available. These story events reveal fragments of the world’s past, each accompanied by hand-painted illustrations, created without the use of any AI.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]
This demo is just the beginning. We’re hard at work on new maps, additional artifacts, deeper mechanics, and more story chapters.

[i]Your feedback is incredibly important to us — and we’re listening. Let us know what worked, what didn’t, and what you’d love to see next. Whether it’s through a review, the Steam forums, or our social media, we’d love to hear from you.[/i]
